description: This source file defines interfaces and classes related to representing and manipulating ranges on a virtual ring using uint values. It includes interfaces like IRingRange, ISingleRange, and internal implementations such as SingleRange and GeneralMultiRange, along with a RangeFactory for creating range objects. The context suggests it's part of Orleans' internal runtime for consistent hashing or partitioning mechanisms.

classes.name: SingleRange
classes.description: Represents a contiguous range on a virtual ring with a begin (exclusive) and end (inclusive). Implements IRingRangeInternal, IEquatable<SingleRange>, ISingleRange, and ISpanFormattable. Provides methods for range checking, merging, and size calculation.

classes.name: GeneralMultiRange
classes.description: Represents a collection of multiple ranges on the ring, supports overlap detection, merging, and range containment checks.

methods.name: RangeFactory.CreateFullRange
methods.description: Creates a range representing the full ring.

methods.name: RangeFactory.CreateRange
methods.description: Creates a range from begin (exclusive) to end (inclusive).

methods.name: RangeFactory.CreateRange (List<IRingRange>)
methods.description: Creates a union range from a list of ranges, merging overlaps.

methods.name: RangeFactory.GetEquallyDividedSubRange
methods.description: Divides a range into equal parts and returns one sub-range.

methods.name: RangeFactory.GetSubRanges
methods.description: Extracts sub-ranges from a given range.
